*Source: [Polished Commander & Warleader](https://www.drivethrurpg.com/en/product/585170/diamond-polished-spheres-commander-and-warleader-sphere)*

*Administrators take an active role in understanding and shaping their situation, viewing conflict as a struggle that expands far beyond the battlefield.*

## Trade Tradition

If this is this character's first level in any class, the administrator may select a trade tradition of their choice, and have an adroit trade rank.

This replaces the commander's normal class skills.

## Blended Training

Whenever an administrator would gain a combat talent from their class level progression, they may choose to instead gain a skill talent. An administrator uses their practitioner modifier as their operative ability modifier.

This alters combat training.

## Clear Communicator

At 1st level, the administrator gains the Warleader sphere as a bonus sphere, plus an additional Communication or Warleader talent at each odd level after 1st.

Allies benefitting from the administrator's *rapport* are treated as though they were benefitting from the administrator's Warleader sphere effects (such as determining when to benefit from an enhanced tactic or battlefield specialty).

This alters battlefield operator.

**Special - Limited Archetype Compatibility:** If another archetype alters battlefield operator, it may stack with this archetype (applying the new archetype's modifications to battlefield operator first; for example, the marshal commander would require the 1st level talent be a (tactic), or the dreadlord commander would allow the administrator-dreadlord to select Communication, Death, or Warleader talents at each odd level after 1st). An archetype that replaces battlefield operator in a way that does not grant a talent every odd level is incompatible.

## Administrator Enhanced Tactics

The administrator has unique and exclusive access to the following enhanced tactics:

### Chain of Custody

The administrator gains the Communication sphere as a bonus sphere, selecting the Tandem Motorics (rapport) (*Diamond Spheres: Harmony & Discord*) talent if they do not already possess it. The administrator's *rapport* may include Tandem Motorics as bonus (rapport) (in addition to any other (rapport) effects applied).

In addition, the administrator gains the following option:

- *Soldier, Catch!*: As a move action, the administrator grants an ally sharing their *rapport* a bonus move action to use Tandem Motorics.

### Working Relationship

The administrator gains the Communication sphere Conversational Decorum talent as a bonus talent. While an ally can see or hear the administrator and shares a *rapport* with them, that ally may use the administrator's Diplomacy, Intimidate, and Profession (soldier) bonuses in place of their own.

**Special - Decorum:** If the administrator possesses an archetype that alters the decorum feature, this enhanced tactic instead allows allies to use those skill's bonuses.
